findings.detail: The extracted issuer_name includes debt category, geography, sector, type, investment date, maturity date, and interest-rate text instead of only the Portfolio Company value.

rationale: Raw SOI table 42 keeps Portfolio Company, Type of Investment, Investment Date, Maturity Date, Interest Rate, cost, and fair value in separate columns; the observed issuer_name concatenates those neighboring fields into the issuer field. The source issuer for the cited row is only Maple Raptor Acquisition Inc. (dba Rentsync), so the fmt_issuer_name flag is a real extraction/column-boundary error.
